title: Trying All Sorts Of Things, I
summary: Fear is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Trying all sorts of things, I have grown weary, but still, they will not leave me alone
lifeApplication: Read the line until fear is no longer the loudest narrator in the room. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
